work_package: V1-WP2 — Canonical Project Package Schema & Adapter Mapping
frozen_invariants_from_wp1: One shared renderer for all projects
Canonical model is authoritative and immutable from viewer presentation logic
T00-T08 standard views with T09/T10 extensions
Presentation and Engineering modes share one package
No silent invention of engineering facts
No project-specific credentials or SKU/customer logic in shared renderer
wp2_decisions: Project package is split into manifest/config/objects/relationships/evidence/findings/views resources
Canonical objects use stable project-scoped IDs
Canonical relationships are separate from non-canonical presentation intents
Relationship attributes are sparse and evidence-gated
Legacy keys/statuses are preserved when migration is not lossless
KAYAS topobj IDs and canonical counts remain unchanged during viewer-only migration
KAYAS AINT records map only to presentation_intents
Haven HN nodes map through an explicit controlled domain/role table
Haven HT.r entries require evidence-aware relationship typing
Haven HT.p RECOMMENDED and DESIGN_TO_FINALIZE default to OPEN-CONFIRMATION REQUIRED until provenance is reconciled
Haven coordinates are presentation hints only
Credentials are outside the package contract

KAYAS.special_rule: AnyBackup vendor reconciliation remains OPEN-CONFIRMATION REQUIRED

Haven Healthcare.special_rule: Do not treat RECOMMENDED as a DCTS authority/status without provenance reconciliation
